activities.question: Connect cause and effect for A sample of normal double -stranded DNA was found to have thymine content of 27%.
activities.instructions: Choose only the options supported by the chapter and arrange them where needed.
activities.sourceTextSummary: Class 12 Biology board-style practice for Biology Data Abstractor Question Bank: Solved Question Practice.

correctItems.text: The Class 12 Biology question asks: A sample of normal double -stranded DNA was found to have thymine content of 27%. What will be the expected proportion of guanine in this strand? A. 23% B. 32% C. 36% D. 73% 1.

The accepted answer direction is: A. 23% According to Chargaff’s rules, in DNA, A =T and G=C; Thus, A +T+G+C =100 Given T = 27% so A=T =27% Thus A+T = 27 +27 =54% Thus, G+C =100 – 54 = 46% Since G = C so G = 46/2 =23% 1.

correctItems.text: The table is about A sample of normal double -stranded DNA was found to have thymine content of 27% and must be interpreted, not copied.

The Class 12 Biology question asks: A sample of normal double -stranded DNA was found to have thymine content of 27%. What will be the expected proportion of guanine in this strand? A. 23% B. 32% C. 36% D. 73% 1.

The accepted answer direction is: A. 23% According to Chargaff’s rules, in DNA, A =T and G=C; Thus, A +T+G+C =100 Given T = 27% so A=T =27% Thus A+T = 27 +27 =54% Thus, G+C =100 – 54 = 46% Since G = C so G = 46/2 =23% 1.
A strong response follows this sequence: Start with key fact/formula, Explain or work stepwise, End with final answer.
